items.constructedResponseAnswer: The speed is constant at 30 miles per hour between 30 and 40 seconds

items.stem: A student used the diagram shown below to support their work in representing the relationship among the lengths of the sides, in units, of a right triangle. The student then showed how the diagram relates to the Pythagorean theorem, but made an error as shown below. What is the error that the student made and what are the correct steps needed to show how the Pythagorean theorem shows the relationship among the lengths of the sides, in units, of the right triangle?
items.constructedResponseAnswer: The student swapped a leg for the hypotenuse: the legs are 3 and 4 and the hypotenuse is 5, so 3 squared plus 4 squared is 5 squared, or 9 + 16 = 25
